input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for user detail. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to interact with student functionality, so that I can accomplish my student-related tasks.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
